title: Book Three · Chapter 127: At the Zero
story:
On Wednesday morning, Mr Sun gives Ronan six small boards to measure.

They are finished pieces for a set of shelves. Their sizes must go on the paper before an adult packs them.

Ronan lays the first board on the low table. He opens the measuring tape and pulls it along the edge.

Forty-one centimetres.

He writes the number on a small label and puts it beside the board.

The next piece has the same length. He writes another label and moves to the third.

Dad comes to the table with a cloth. He looks at the first number, then at the tape.

“Where did you start?”

Ronan points to the end.

Dad bends closer. The first centimetre of tape is folded under.

“That is one. The zero is here.”

Ronan looks again. He has put the one mark beside the board's edge. At the other end, the tape says forty-one.

Dad opens the folded part and lays the zero at the edge.

Now the other end is at forty.

Ronan lets out a breath.

“I added one.”

“You started one too far along.”

He takes the two labels off. Dad leaves him the tape and moves back to his own work.

Mr Sun comes over before Ronan starts again. Ronan shows him the two wrong numbers.

“I need to check all six.”

“Yes. I will pack the other order first.”

Ronan puts the old labels aside. He starts at zero and checks both ends before he writes.

It takes ten more minutes. Mr Sun has to wait for the last pair. Ronan brings all six boards with their new labels and explains the delay.

Mr Sun checks one himself. Then he packs the pieces. Ronan holds the new labels flat on top. This time, the numbers face up so Mr Sun can read them.

At the short break, Ronan looks at the two wasted labels.

“Forty-one,” he says to Dad.

“Forty now.”

“It grew smaller very quickly.”

Dad smiles. “The tape moved. The wood stayed.”

Ronan folds the wrong labels and puts them in the waste box. He leaves the tape open on the table for the next job.

Before twelve, another customer asks about a board. Ronan takes the tape, checks the zero, and puts the end flat beside the wood.

The customer holds the other end for him. Together they look at the same mark. Ronan says the size aloud before he writes it down.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

measuring tape＝卷尺；centimetre＝厘米；zero＝零刻度；delay＝耽搁。

## 理解问题

1. 为什么Ronan最初把四十厘米记成四十一厘米？
2. 这次错误实际花掉了哪些时间和材料？木板有没有因此被错误切割？

## 读句子

**The first centimetre of tape is folded under.**

拆开看：The first centimetre of tape / is folded / under.

卷尺开头的一厘米／被折着／压到了下面。
